parameters.name: FullBackupCycle
parameters.description: The full backup cycle, in days. Valid values: 3 to 9.

parameters.name: MinHFileBackupCount
parameters.description: The number of full backups to retain. Valid values: 3 to 8.

parameters.name: NextFullBackupDate
parameters.description: The time of the next full backup. The specified time must be at least 6 minutes later than the current time.

parameters.name: Tables
parameters.description: The tables to back up. Specify one table name per line. Wildcards are supported. An asterisk (*) indicates all tables.
